title: Go-live triage playbook + listing snippet experiments
body:
Purpose:
This is a pragmatic go-live triage playbook for partner listings (cloud marketplace + partner shelf). It combines an ops-first runbook for the first 72 hours of a listing rollout with a small experiment matrix for tile/snippet microcopy. The goal: reduce time-to-fix for common launch failures, capture fast telemetry to validate copy variants, and minimize manual back-and-forth with partners during the soft launch window.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: GTM launch leads, partner ops, product launch engineers, SRE on-call, solutions engineering.
- Scope: initial publish, first 72-hours monitoring, triage steps, rollback criteria, and copy/messaging experiments to run during canary traffic. Not intended to replace legal/compliance gating; those must be cleared prior to publish.

Quick decisions and thresholds (TL;DR):
- Abort publish and roll back if >5% of marketplace API calls return 5xx for >10 minutes or if provisioning SLA fails for >3% of trial enrollments over 30 minutes.
- Promote variant A to wide-rollout if CTR on trial CTA is +20% relative lift and no QoS regressions across latency/cost.
- Escalate to SRE lead when error budgets consume >50% of the 72-hour window.

Runbook (step-by-step):
Pre-publish (checklist, must be green):
1) Asset inventory: hero tile, 3x screenshot sizes, short description (<=200 chars), long description (<=1,200 chars), trial CTA copy, tagline, entitlements doc, SKU mapping.
2) Technical gating: provisioning API endpoint smoke test passes (5 sequential calls, <500ms p50, correct JSON schema).
3) Auth & Entitlement: trial token minting validated with a real partner account; license key rotation test.
4) Telemetry hooks in place: events logged for publish.confirm, tile.view, tile.click, provisioning.start, provisioning.success, provisioning.failure.
5) Run a staging publish to private tenant and walk through entire onboarding.

Publish window (day 0):
- T-10m: Notify #marketplace-launch channel with manifest and runbook link; set automated reminders to the on-call SRE and partner ops.
- T: Start canary rollout to 1–5% traffic (region-limited if possible).
- T+2m: Verify tile renders correctly across iOS/Android/web screenshot sizes.
- T+15m: Validate telemetry ingestion (look for publish.confirm event and tile.view sample).
- T+30m: Check provision success rate and trial issuance. If success_rate >= 98% and error_rate < 0.5%, increase canary to 25%.

Monitoring & Triage (first 72 hours):
- Dashboards to watch: per-tile p50/p95 render latency, per-route error rates (4xx/5xx), provisioning success rate, trial activation CTR, billing entitlements mismatches.
- Short-circuit tests every 30m for 6 hours, then hourly: 10 scripted end-to-end provision attempts.
- If a critical failure (see failure modes) occurs, move to containment -> rollback checklist below.

Common failure modes and fast fixes:
1) Tile asset mismatch (wrong image, corrupted JSON)
  - Symptom: tile.view events show 0 renders; manual load returns 502 for asset CDN.
  - Quick fix: flip traffic to cached fallback image (pre-registered), patch asset on CDN, purge relevant CDN keys.
2) Provisioning API schema drift
  - Symptom: provisioning.failure spikes, invalid_payload errors in logs.
  - Quick fix: revert to previous schema handling code in edge service (hotfix), or toggle compatibility mode flag in proxy.
3) Entitlement mismatch / billing mapping failure
  - Symptom: trials fail during activation with entitlement.not_found.
  - Quick fix: run entitlement backfill job for preflighted SKUs; temporarily enable manual approval flow for affected customers while fix is applied.
4) Increased latency caused by new redirect rules
  - Symptom: p95 latency for tile.render increases >200ms relative to baseline.
  - Quick fix: roll back redirect rule, route to previous CDN edge.

Rollback checklist (when to rollback):
- Immediate rollback triggers:
  - Provisioning failure rate >3% for 30 minutes at canary stage.
  - Marketplace API 5xx rate >5% for 10 minutes across affected region.
  - Security incident or data leak.
- Rollback actions:
  1) Pause listing availability in catalogue admin.
  2) Swap to previous tile version / asset set.
  3) Revert any schema changes or proxy flags.
  4) Inform partner + internal stakeholders with incident stub (see communication template).

Communication template (send within 15 minutes of rollback decision):
Subject: [Action required] Listing rollback for <partner-name> - <short-reason>
Body: quick bullet list: what happened, who triaged, immediate impact, next steps, ETA for postmortem. Link to incident ticket: JIRA-XXXXX.

Copy & snippet experiments (A/B matrix to run during canary):
Rationale: small microcopy changes often change trial uptake. Run low-risk experiments against canary traffic and measure trial-CTA CTR and trial activation rate. Variants are intentionally constrained to reduce compliance/legal review scope.
Experiment matrix (3-week cadence during early launch):
- Slot: tile short description (<=200 chars)
  - Control: "Low-latency LLM inference, pay-as-you-go"
  - Variant A: "Fast, reliable LLM inference with predictable cost"
  - Variant B: "Ship LLM features faster — predictable latency & pricing"
  Metrics: tile_click_rate, trial_signup_rate, provisioning_success_rate.
- Slot: CTA button copy
  - Control: "Start free trial"
  - Variant A: "Try free — no card required"
  - Variant B: "Start sandbox (instant)"
  Metrics: CTA_click_to_trial_rate, downstream activation.
- Slot: Tagline under title (one line)
  - Control: none
  - Variant A: "SLA-backed inference for production apps"
  - Variant B: "Engineered for low latency and predictable cost"
  Metrics: session_duration_on_tile, downstream doc clickthrough.

Experiment rules and constraints:
- Only one slot changed at a time per market to reduce cross-effects.
- Experiment window: 72 hours minimum, stop early if provisioning_success_rate degrades by >1.5% relative to control.
- Statistical threshold: require >=10% relative lift with p-value <0.1 to promote to next stage (this is for fast feedback—use conservative thresholds for full rollouts).

Telemetry & instrumentation checklist (must be in place before experiments):
- Event names: partner.tile.view, partner.tile.click, partner.cta.click, partner.trial.request, partner.trial.success, partner.trial.failure, partner.entitlement.mismatch
- Label attributes: partner_id, listing_id, variant_id, region, user_cohort, latency_ms, error_code
- Logging: retain high-sample debug logs for first 72 hours and then downsample to 1% thereafter.

Post-launch retrospectives & measurements (deliverables within 7 days):
- Launch readout doc (owner: GTM lead) with: traffic volumes, errors, experiment results, customer issues, billing discrepancies.
- Incident timeline and RCA for any rollback event (owner: SRE lead).
- Copy promotion decision: promote variant if it met thresholds and no QoS regressions.

Appendices:
- Quick Slack snippets for partner comms (short, neutral, actionable).
  - "We detected increased provisioning failures after the publish. We’ve paused the listing and reverted to the previous asset set; we’ll follow up with an update in 30m."
  - "Congrats — your new listing is live in canary (5% traffic). Expect a follow-up with initial telemetry in 1 hour."
- Short list of useful tickets/links (examples):
  - Confluence: CONF-4607 marketplace-launch-runbook
  - Jira: GMKT-1821 listing-publish-canary
  - GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace/pull/511

Notes to self / known gaps:
- We do not yet have automated rollback for entitlement mapping failures; that should be prioritized in next-quarter SRE backlog.
- Need a faster legal check path for microcopy variants that touch compliance language (data residency / security claims).

Owner & collaborators:
- Owner: Maya Chen (GTM launch lead)
- Collaborators: Oscar Ramirez, Priya Nair, Ben Thornton
